func (a *Attempt) Phase(phase string) error {
	if a.err != nil {
		return a.err
	}
	switch phase {
	case "material":
		a.PhaseMaterial()
	case "release":
		a.PhaseRelease()
	case "image":
		a.PhaseImage()
	case "sign":
		a.PhaseSign()
	case "launch":
		a.PhaseLaunch()
	case "complete":
		a.PhaseComplete()
	case "operator":
		a.PhaseOperator()
	case "services":
		a.PhaseServices()
	case "members":
		a.PhaseMembers()
	case "plan":
		a.PhasePlan()
	case "terrabase":
		a.PhaseTerraBase()
	case "status":
		a.PhaseStatus()
	case "up":
		for _, p := range Phases {
			fmt.Fprintln(a.Out, "==", p)
			if e := a.Phase(p); e != nil {
				return e
			}
		}
	default:
		a.fail(fmt.Errorf("unknown attempt phase %q", phase))
	}
	return a.err
}
